_comment: ADR-037 register fragment, change motions-stages-and-themes (REQ-MST-001 and REQ-MST-002, matrix rows mot-08 and mot-15). Theme is the configurable list of policy themes (beleidsvelden) a motion can be tagged with; Decision.themes stores the theme names, so the motions list can filter on readable values. lifecycle, outcome and themes become facetable, which gives the Motions list its stage, result and theme filters.

Theme.title: Theme
Theme.description: A policy theme motions can be tagged with, such as housing or climate.

name.title: Name
name.description: The theme as members see it on a motion and in the filter.

themes.title: Themes
themes.description: The policy themes this motion is about, by name, picked from the configured themes.
themes.x-notes: Names, not ids: the motions list filters on this facet and shows its values as they are stored. DecisionFormDialog offers the configured theme names.
